summary: On PostgreSQL 18+, invalidates the server-prepared statement cache when a search_path ParameterStatus (GUC_REPORT) reports a changed value, skipping the SET/RESET command-tag scan once the server reports search_path.

tests.evidence: Behaviour change; adds searchPathPreparedStatementInPlpgsqlInvalidatesOnGucReport covering both pre-18 failure and 18+ re-prepare, and existing SET/RESET tests run through the report path on 18.

user_docs.evidence: server-prepare.md updated, but sehrope flagged that 'pgJDBC detects them wherever they happen and re-prepares automatically' overclaims: "$user", public plus SET ROLE changes resolution without a search_path report; author agreed to tighten wording and add a note.

doc_comments.evidence: Non-obvious comments in receiveParameterStatus and processResults explain the ordering against onParameterStatus and when the scan is skipped; they match the code.

change_description.evidence: User-visible behaviour change on PG 18+ but the PR adds no CHANGELOG.md entry, while the repo keeps an Unreleased 42.7.12 section that feature PRs fill in.

performance.evidence: receiveParameterStatus and the SET/RESET branch gain a map lookup and string compare; negligible, and unchanged values cost no invalidation.

security.evidence: No auth, TLS, or untrusted-input parsing touched.

backward_compat.evidence: On 18+ invalidation now follows server reports (e.g. also after ROLLBACK of a SET), which only adds re-prepares; pre-18 path unchanged.

concurrency.evidence: Epoch bump happens on the protocol-reading thread like the existing command-tag path.

error_model.evidence: No error paths added or changed.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial protocol-path logic (compare with previous value before onParameterStatus, skip scan when reported); the $user + SET ROLE gap the reviewer found is pre-existing, not introduced.

user_value.evidence: Fixes a real class of 'cached plan must not change result type' errors with no new option.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Behaviour now differs by server version (18+ vs older), which the docs describe.

contradictions.evidence: Docs, comments, and tests were updated together and agree; the only mismatch is the docs' scope wording already counted under user_docs.

observability.evidence: No new failure or fallback state that needs a signal.

spec_conformance.evidence: Interprets the PostgreSQL protocol: ParameterStatus/GUC_REPORT for search_path from PG 18, including the initial report at startup used as the baseline.

plan.why: Small, cohesive change to one protocol code path with its docs and test.
